Fictional 30-year-old Japanese adult female. Cheerful bakery-cafe manager with a sophisticated, playful influencer-like presence. Small, soft, roundish oval face, gently plump cheeks, rounded chin. Large, expressive dark brown double-lidded eyes, balanced between almond and round, with corners turning down very slightly. Neatly groomed soft-arched eyebrows, natural straight nose with a slightly rounded tip, soft plump lips with naturally upturned corners. Light warm-neutral Japanese skin with realistic pores, light natural redness, subtle freckles across the nose, and slight asymmetry. A single tiny beauty mark directly below the outer corner of her anatomical left eye. Signature smile is a bright, playful smile showing teeth, creating dimples on both cheeks. Hair is shoulder-length smooth straight layered bob. Slightly off-center part, with only the ends curling naturally inward. The surface layer, roots, crown, parting, bangs, and upper hair framing the face are a uniform glossy black to deep charcoal. A cool smoky gray to graphite silver inner color is strictly located underneath that dark surface layer, visible only where hair is tucked behind the ears and at the lower inner ends. No center split, no half-and-half coloring, no center band, no gray roots or crown, no face-framing highlights, no ombre/gradient, no full-head gray. Modern influencer makeup with distinct eyelashes, subtle taupe eyeliner, rose-beige lips, without smoothing the skin like plastic. Thin round black metal or gunmetal glasses are an optional signature accessory. Maintain the facial features, face shape, freckles, beauty mark placement, dimples, black surface hair, inner color placement, hair length, and adult age perception of the fictional adult described here; do not resemble identifiable real people.

Physical Consistency:
Height approximately 166 cm. Long legs, confident posture. Healthy, lightly toned adult hourglass figure. Bust is naturally full, with realistic base width, forward projection, soft weight, and gravity proportional to the ribcage. Waist is cinched yet realistic; hips and buttocks are moderately plump with a slightly fuller roundness, connecting naturally from pelvis to thighs. Maintain height, ribcage, waist, pelvis, hip volume, and limb proportions across perspective changes. Wear normal opaque clothing with natural fabric tension. No cleavage-lifting push-ups, no exaggerated cleavage, no padding, no extreme corseting, no spherical implant-like shapes, no impossibly tiny waist, no exaggerated hips, no BBL-style contours.

Shooting Situation:
12:10 PM. A port diner. Eating a set meal prepared by someone else, taking a relaxed breather.

Location and Background:
A rustic port diner. A set meal of grilled fish, a bowl of rice, and miso soup.

Outfit:
Thin, opaque charcoal form-fitting sleeveless top, light ankle-length black maxi skirt, black flat sandals. Thin black-rimmed round glasses, thin silver hoops, small black shoulder bag.

Pose and Action:
Sitting on a chair, naturally holding two chopsticks in the right hand, pausing over the dish. Left hand beside the rice bowl. Expression / Face direction: Face nearly straight to the camera, neck not tilted to the sides. Shoulders lowered, relaxed eyes from enjoying the meal. Lips closed, corners of the mouth subtly and slightly lifted. A relieved expression without showing teeth.

Composition and Angle of View:
Taken by a friend sitting opposite using a standard smartphone 1x lens, approximately 1 m away, height 1.15 m. Head, upper body, both hands, and the entire set meal.
Output only a single undivided image with a final size of 1086×1448px, aspect ratio 3:4.

Lighting and Atmosphere:
Side light from the window and modest interior diner lighting.

Photo Texture:
Depict a single minimally processed HEIC photograph taken with a standard smartphone's default camera app. Do not confuse character, body, and hair shape with surface finish. Follow a single camera-specified AF plane; do not relight, denoise, or sharpen only the distant face. Details continuously soften according to distance. Within the recognizable range of the face, maintain multiple broad tonal variations simultaneously, such as warmth on one cheek, uneven sheen on the T-zone, different undertones under each eye, and slight redness on the nose, without drawing pores on a distant face. On close, resolvable skin, retain non-repeating low-contrast color variations, pressure redness, wrinkle shadows, and sparse pore variations. Present makeup as real pigment with slightly uneven edges, keeping natural color differences between lips and teeth. Maintain uneven exposure and white balance, unlifted shadows, a few stray hairs, off-center composition, shadow noise, subtle sharpening near the AF point, and HEIC compression. Make it look like an unedited snapshot from a personal camera roll.

Mandatory Requirements:
Output only a single undivided smartphone photo of an adult female that matches all scene specifications. Fulfill both the scene pass criteria and natural smartphone photo quality standards.

One fictional 30-year-old adult female. Friend and photographer are off-screen.
Pass Criteria:
1) Maintain the woman's adult face, round glasses, black shoulder-length bob, and gray underlayer.
2) Outfit, setting, main action, and accessories must match; finger interactions and object contact must look natural.
3) Specified angle of view and overall framing must be achieved.
4) An everyday smartphone photo with distance-dependent resolution falloff, natural skin tonal variations, and texture differences.
5) Face nearly straight to the camera, neck not tilted to the sides. Shoulders lowered, relaxed eyes from enjoying the meal. Lips closed, corners of the mouth subtly and slightly lifted. A relieved expression without showing teeth.

Maintain specified accessories.

Black shoulder-length straight bob with gray inner color only around the ears and lower layer. Upper layer of hair is black. Maintain round glasses. Opaque fabric.

Subject has exactly two arms and two hands. Hand-to-object contact and body support must be natural. Strictly adhere to the expression and gaze for this scene. Signature smile and dimples are traits when smiling, not a constant toothy smile.

Single AF is on the face. One standalone vertical 3:4 photo. Do not crop the specified range of head or limbs at the frame edges, leaving margins.
Only one image. Maintain the specified aspect ratio and conditions to frame the whole scene.

Natural shadows and exposure differences.

Only one AF plane. Do not apply exposure correction, relighting, smoothing, or restoration solely to the face. Preserve broad tonal differences for a distant face and irregular variations on close skin; keep smartphone-specific processing artifacts localized.

Depict only one clearly adult fictional female as the sole subject of a single undivided photograph. Exactly one head, one face, exactly two anatomically connected arms, and naturally shaped hands. Another person's hand in the foreground can only be added if explicitly specified in the scene or props, and that hand must be clearly separated from the subject's body. No text, panels, duplicate persons, or alternate angles.
